# Versions of the libraries whose behaviour the generated files capture.
# electricity/scripts/generate_*.py take their expected outputs from
# Circuitry's own code and, through it, from these libraries, so an
# unpinned upgrade could change a committed file with no change in this
# repository. CI installs Circuitry with these as constraints
# (`pip install -e . -c electricity/scripts/generator-constraints.txt`).
# To upgrade one: change it here, rerun every generator without --check,
# commit the regenerated files, and let electricity's Rust tests replay them.
cel-python==0.5.0
chevron==0.14.0
jsonschema==4.26.0
PyYAML==6.0.3
